_published_faq.name: How do I add $nipp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add $nipp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://snipp-cecb57df.alpic.live/.

_published_faq.name: Is $nipp MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, $nipp scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the $nipp MCP server provide?
What are the best alternatives to $nipp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to $nipp in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
$nipp does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
$nipp is developed by Snipp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
